Best guide and build for Zhu Yuan from ZZZ (Zenless Zone Zero). Zhu Yuan is an rank character with the Ether attribute who belongs to the Attack Specialty and who is part of the N.E.P.S. faction.

sections.heading: Review
sections.text:
Zhu Yuan is a Ranged/Melee hybrid S-Rank Ether Combat Agent specializing in delivering massive Ether Burst damage to stunned enemies with her unique ammunition system . With her high mobility, Zhu Yuan integrates multiple Dash attacks into her optimal damage combos, allowing her to reposition mid-attack and implement Invulnerability frames while dealing optimal damage.
 Zhu Yuan’s kit revolves around her Shotgun Shell gauge, which can hold up to 9 Enhanced Shells. These shells empower her Basic and Dash Attacks. She switches between two modes of attack: Assault Mode and Suppressive Mode.
 Assault Mode : This mode includes most of her Default Attack sequences. It deals low damage but focuses on generating Enhanced Shotgun Shells.

 Suppressive Mode : This mode features high-damage Charged Attacks. It can be accessed by holding down the basic attack, causing Zhu Yuan to perform a backflip before entering Suppressive Mode. In this mode, while holding, Zhu Yuan continuously consumes 1-3 Enhanced Shotgun Shells to deal massive damage with her attacks.

 Zhu Yuan has some of the most varied combos available in the game, with each offering unique benefits in different situations. Learning and mastering them all is quite a challenge. Fortunately, it’s possible to focus on the most commonly used, highest-damage combos, which this guide will cover. Zhu Yuan has access to two completely different basic attack combos, one for each Suppressive and Assault mode.
 Zhu Yuan’s Assault Mode Basic Attacks consist of a six-part attack combo (despite the game only listing five of the six parts). Here is the breakdown of the combo:
 Assault Mode Basic P1: Physical Melee Kick

 Assault Mode Basic P2: Ether Ranged Shotgun Blast

 Assault Mode Basic P3: Physical Melee Multi-Kick

 Assault Mode Basic P4: Ether Ranged Shotgun Jump Blast (Generates 1 Shell)

 Assault Mode Basic P5: Ether Ranged Shotgun Dash Blast (Generates 1 Shell)

 Assault Mode Basic P6: Ether Ranged Shotgun Slide

 The most valuable attacks in this sequence are Basic P4 and P5, as they deal the best damage and also generate Zhu Yuan's shells. Ideally, we’d like to access these as frequently as possible.
 Another unique aspect of Zhu Yuan’s basic attacks is that she can weave in a Dash Attack after any of the combo sequences above by triggering a Basic Attack by holding down the directional key. In this guide, we’ll be talking specifically about her left and right Dash Attacks (they’re the same as each other), as they are the most effective in her kit and the ones you should be using whenever mentioned. Dashing after attacks in this way will alter the sequencing of her next attack depending on which you dashed after. Here is a list of how using a side dash after each part of the Assault Mode basic attack changes things:
 Assault Mode Basic P1 -> Dash Attack -> Assault Mode Basic P3 (Optimal)

 Assault Mode Basic P2 -> Dash Attack -> Assault Mode Basic P3 (Avoid)

 Assault Mode Basic P3 -> Dash Attack -> Loop Back to Assault Mode Basic P3 (Avoid)

 Assault Mode Basic P4 -> Dash Attack -> Assault Mode Basic P5 (Avoid)

 Assault Mode Basic P5 -> Dash Attack -> Loop to Assault Mode Basic P3 (Optimal)

 Assault Mode Basic P6 -> Dash Attack -> Loop Back to Assault Mode Basic P3 (Avoid)

 The changes to attack ordering allow Zhu Yuan to execute higher damage, faster combos that generate more shells. Here is an example of a combo in action:
 Assault Mode Basic P1

 Dash Attack

 Assault Mode Basic P3

 Assault Mode Basic P4

 Assault Mode Basic P5

 Dash Attack

 Assault Mode Basic P3

 Assault Mode Basic P4

 Assault Mode Basic P5

 By using Dash Attacks, we can speed up Zhu Yuan’s standard rotation and loop/skip to the best parts of it.
 Zhu Yuan’s other Basic Attack moves are within Suppressive Mode, which, as mentioned above, needs to be entered by holding down the Basic Attack and waiting for Zhu Yuan to perform a short preparatory flip. The time needed for Zhu Yuan to enter Suppressive Mode is roughly 0.5 seconds, long enough that you don’t want to be constantly moving in and out of Assault and Suppressive unless necessary. The best approach is to enter Suppressive mode only when you have sufficient Enhanced Shells to consume (5 or 9 being optimal). Additionally, several abilities in Zhu Yuan’s kit allow her to immediately enter Suppressive Mode without delay as long as you immediately begin using Suppressive Mode Basics right after they finish. These abilities are:
 EX Special Attack

 Ultimate Attack

 Chain Attack

 After entering Suppression mode, continuously holding down the Basic Attack will cause Zhu Yuan to fire an Enhanced Shotgun combo consisting of 3 parts which if available, will each consume a number of Shotgun Shells to deal either tiny Physical (un-enhanced) or massive Ether damage (enhanced). Due to the poor multipliers on Zhu Yuan’s un-enhanced Suppressive Basics it’s never worth using them without Shells available. Here is how many Shells each attack uses:
 Suppressive Mode Basic P1 = 1 Shell

 Suppressive Mode Basic P2 = 1 Shell

 Suppressive Mode Basic P3 = 3 Shells (Deals triple the damage of P1 and P2)

 Just like Zhu Yuan’s Assault Mode Basic Attacks, she can also make use of a special Suppressive Mode Dodge Attack to alter and improve her Basic Attack sequences. We’ll again be making use of side Dash Attacks (left and right) as they are the most competitive in most cases. Here is how dashes affect the combo:
 Suppressive Mode Basic P1 -> Suppressive Mode Dash Attack -> Suppressive Mode Basic P3

 Suppressive Mode Basic P2 -> Suppressive Mode Dash Attack -> Suppressive Mode Basic P3

 Suppressive Mode Basic P3 -> Suppressive Mode Dash Attack -> Suppressive Mode Basic P3 (Loop)

 The key takeaway here is that we can use a Suppressive Mode Dash Attack following a Suppressive Mode Basic P3 to skip straight back to another P3 incredibly quickly, allowing us to consume our Shells much faster and increase Zhu Yuan’s burst potential. Here is an example combo that dumps all 9 Shells as fast as possible (a full gauge):
 Suppressive Mode Basic P1 (1 Shell)

 Suppressive Mode Basic P2 (1 Shell)

 Suppressive Mode Basic P3 (3 Shells)

 Suppressive Mode Dash Attack (1 Shell)

 Suppressive Mode Basic P3 (3 Shells)

 As mentioned above, Zhu Yuan has a Dash Attack for both Assault Mode and Suppressive Mode. For both modes, she has different Dash attacks for forward, back, left and right, but left and right are primarily used in both modes for her combos. They can be not only used mid-combo for cancels but also in general combat outside of combos.
 Zhu Yuan’s Dodge Counter is a quick Shotgun Blast that deals Ether damage and generates 1 Shotgun Shell, making it an optimal way to stack up Shells quickly against fast-attacking enemies. Following this Dodge Counter, Zhu Yuan skips straight to her Assault Mode Basic P3, allowing her to quickly chain attacks together if desired.
 Zhu Yuan’s Quick Assist and Assist Follow-Up both launch a Shotgun Blast dealing Ether damage and generating Shotgun Shells. Her Quick Assist generates 1 Shell and her Assist Follow-Up generates 3.
 Zhu Yuan’s EX Special Attack, Chain Attack, and Ultimate are all functionally the same but with varying damage multipliers. All of them trigger massive Shotgun Blasts that immediately place Zhu Yuan in Suppressive Mode allowing for immediate usage of Suppressive Mode Basics and generating 3 Shells each.
 To round off her kit, Zhu Yuan features an incredible Core Passive as well as an Additional Ability, both of which tremendously boost her damage output. Zhu Yuan’s Core Passive boosts the damage of all her Shell-Enhanced Suppressive Mode Basic Attacks and Dash Attacks by up to 40%, further increasing against Stunned targets by another 40% for a total of 80%. She also gains 6 Shells at the start of each combat. Meanwhile, with her Additional Ability if Zhu Yuan has a Support character or a character sharing either her Faction in the team, she’ll gain 30% Crit Rate for 10 seconds after using an EX Special, Chain, or Ultimate. This buff is all but guaranteed to be permanently active during Zhu Yuan’s main burst window where she unloads all her Shells (usually against Stunned enemies).
 Zhu Yuan’s build-and-spend kit plays perfectly into a Burst damage playstyle where she can build up Shells, Energy, and her Ultimate to unleash strong attacks on Stunned enemies in an incredibly short amount of time. At the time of her release, Zhu Yuan delivers the most Burst damage during a Stun window in the game, assuming she has all her kit at her disposal.

sections.heading: How to play
sections.text:
Zhu Yuan doesn’t like being on-field all that much, with Assault Mode attacks doing little damage and building few resources, but she can take on the role if necessary, as her Suppressive Mode Shotshell attacks can be very strong.
 The primary goal is to have enough Shotshells and Energy ready before every stun.
 With her Evasive Assist into Assist Follow-Up using up only 1 Assist Point and building 3 Shotshells, it’s an effective way to build them quickly without taking up too much time. This isn’t always ideal, however, as many Stunners don’t work well with on-fielding, it’s fine to have Zhu Yuan be the active character and then make use of her Dodge Counters and, if possible, Assist Counter to a Stunner to get both Shotshells and daze application.
 Zhu Yuan can get away with having 5-6 Shotshells and a little under 3/4s of her Energy before stuns, if being run with a Support that can provide Quick Assists. Manual Chain is mandatory for her best combos. Most moves will have Heavy Attacks that trigger Chain at inopportune times, as making use of Chain Attacks for Shotshell generation is important to get the most damage out.
 Thankfully, it’s very easy to use, as one needs to be holding down Basic Attack for Zhu Yuan’s Suppressive Mode Basic Attacks anyways.

sections.heading: Synergy
sections.text:
Below we list only the most important synergies for Zhu Yuan . The character can work with others if you know what to do and how to use them.

 Dialyn - Dialyn is decidedly the best Stunner for Zhu Yuan and far outperforms even double Support teams. Despite it's fast animations, Zhu Yuan's Ultimate is particularly hard hitting, and when paired with the ability to get 2 Ultimates and a Chain Attack in a combo, it leads to incredibly strong stun bursts. Dialyn's high Daze value and the relative ease in which Zhu Yuan can build resources for stuns leads to quick cycles and at times, more stuns in a fight than what could be achieved with other Stunners.
 Qingyi Anby - On-field Stun options are great for Zhu Yuan because they fill in for her downtime so no on-field time is wasted in between her damage windows. Qingyi is the most natural option and the best choice. She shares a faction with Zhu Yuan, she stuns very quickly, and she applies Stun DMG Multiplier debuffs to increase Zhu Yuan's damage against enemies. This means Zhu Yuan greatly benefits from Qingyi being present in her teams, however Anby is an option you can consider if you don't want to run Double Support team compositions and instead want to run a Stun Agent, as she applies a lot of Daze and fills in for Zhu Yuan's downtime, but beyond that point she lacks in extra utility which makes her viable, but worse.
 Pulchra Trigger - Having an opposite playstyle from Qingyi and Anby, Trigger and Pulchra serve as options that take much less of an on-field presence for Zhu Yuan to take up more of the field time instead. This style of team composition is very similar to her Double Support playstyle, which over time has proven to be her best. Trigger and Pulchra trade off an ability to deal higher Daze than their peers with very low field time and - most importantly - provide buffs to Zhu Yuan. While Qingyi still remains a superior choice as she also has buffs and higher Daze potential, both of these options outclass Anby who gives no buffs to Zhu Yuan whatsoever, making for perfectly good alternatives.
 Seed - Seed can and wants to be paired alongside other Attack Agents who function as main damage dealers in order for her kit to work well. This is because Seed is able to buff Attack Agents in several ways, giving them Energy, ATK, DMG dealt and CRIT DMG increases. For this reason, she works well as a mix of DPS and Support for almost every Attack Agent in the game, including Zhu Yuan.
 Nicole Yuzuha Astra Yao - These 3 generalist Support units are capable of servicing as the Support to any team in the game. Astra Yao provides Quick Assists, extra Chain Attacks, healing, super low field time, ATK, DMG and CRIT DMG buffs which makes her the overall best choice in almost all cases. Yuzuha on the other hand is the ultimate Anomaly buffer who's sporting awesome ATK and DMG% buffs applicable to any Agent as well, giving her strong general use potential. Nicole provides the sought-after DEF Shred and CRIT Rate at M6 which makes her competitive. They can work with any team in the game to great effect, whether that's by themselves or together, Nicole being particularly appreciated with Zhu Yuan as she also activates her Additional Ability which increases the whole party's Ether DMG on top of applying a good chunk of Ether Anomaly.

sections.heading: Synergy
sections.text:
Below we list only the most important synergies for Zhu Yuan . The character can work with others if you know what to do and how to use them.

 Dialyn - Dialyn is decidedly the best Stunner for Zhu Yuan and far outperforms even double Support teams. Despite it's fast animations, Zhu Yuan's Ultimate is particularly hard hitting, and when paired with the ability to get 2 Ultimates and a Chain Attack in a combo, it leads to incredibly strong stun bursts. Dialyn's high Daze value and the relative ease in which Zhu Yuan can build resources for stuns leads to quick cycles and at times, more stuns in a fight than what could be achieved with other Stunners.
 Qingyi Anby - On-field Stun options are great for Zhu Yuan because they fill in for her downtime so no on-field time is wasted in between her damage windows. Qingyi is the most natural option and the best choice. She shares a faction with Zhu Yuan, she stuns very quickly, and she applies Stun DMG Multiplier debuffs to increase Zhu Yuan's damage against enemies. This means Zhu Yuan greatly benefits from Qingyi being present in her teams, however Anby is an option you can consider if you don't want to run Double Support team compositions and instead want to run a Stun Agent, as she applies a lot of Daze and fills in for Zhu Yuan's downtime, but beyond that point she lacks in extra utility which makes her viable, but worse.
 Pulchra Trigger - Having an opposite playstyle from Qingyi and Anby, Trigger and Pulchra serve as options that take much less of an on-field presence for Zhu Yuan to take up more of the field time instead. This style of team composition is very similar to her Double Support playstyle, which over time has proven to be her best. Trigger and Pulchra trade off an ability to deal higher Daze than their peers with very low field time and - most importantly - provide buffs to Zhu Yuan. While Qingyi still remains a superior choice as she also has buffs and higher Daze potential, both of these options outclass Anby who gives no buffs to Zhu Yuan whatsoever, making for perfectly good alternatives.
 Seed - Seed can and wants to be paired alongside other Attack Agents who function as main damage dealers in order for her kit to work well. This is because Seed is able to buff Attack Agents in several ways, giving them Energy, ATK, DMG dealt and CRIT DMG increases. For this reason, she works well as a mix of DPS and Support for almost every Attack Agent in the game, including Zhu Yuan.
 Nicole Yuzuha Astra Yao - These 3 generalist Support units are capable of servicing as the Support to any team in the game. Astra Yao provides Quick Assists, extra Chain Attacks, healing, super low field time, ATK, DMG and CRIT DMG buffs which makes her the overall best choice in almost all cases. Yuzuha on the other hand is the ultimate Anomaly buffer who's sporting awesome ATK and DMG% buffs applicable to any Agent as well, giving her strong general use potential. Nicole provides the sought-after DEF Shred and CRIT Rate at M6 which makes her competitive. They can work with any team in the game to great effect, whether that's by themselves or together, Nicole being particularly appreciated with Zhu Yuan as she also activates her Additional Ability which increases the whole party's Ether DMG on top of applying a good chunk of Ether Anomaly.

 This tier list assesses Agents (characters) based on their combat potential in Zenless Zone Zero's most demanding contents - Deadly Assault (DA) and Shiyu Defense (SD) . Please keep in mind Zenless Zone Zero is a skill-based game and each character has a different playstyle, difficulty level and even special tricks and combos. Zenless Zone Zero is also a team based game and it's only by combining both these factors to the highest level a character can reach optimal performance.

 Endgame Modes

 Pros & Cons
 Pros
 One of the more F2P-friendly characters with strong generalist team options and highly accessible W-Engines;

 Core playstyle is easy to understand and has high mobility, but still leaves lots of room for optimization;

 Belongs in teams with Double Support and Stun + Support units with fairly equal performance, only reinforcing her accessibility.

 Cons
 Zhu Yuan is a combo-based character who can take lots of practice to pick up and play perfectly, presenting a major learning curve;

 Nowadays, significantly outclassed in the Ether DMG department at higher investments by characters like Yixuan.

 Review
 Zhu Yuan is a Ranged/Melee hybrid S-Rank Ether Combat Agent specializing in delivering massive Ether Burst damage to stunned enemies with her unique ammunition system . With her high mobility, Zhu Yuan integrates multiple Dash attacks into her optimal damage combos, allowing her to reposition mid-attack and implement Invulnerability frames while dealing optimal damage.
 Zhu Yuan’s kit revolves around her Shotgun Shell gauge, which can hold up to 9 Enhanced Shells. These shells empower her Basic and Dash Attacks. She switches between two modes of attack: Assault Mode and Suppressive Mode.
 Assault Mode : This mode includes most of her Default Attack sequences. It deals low damage but focuses on generating Enhanced Shotgun Shells.

 Suppressive Mode : This mode features high-damage Charged Attacks. It can be accessed by holding down the basic attack, causing Zhu Yuan to perform a backflip before entering Suppressive Mode. In this mode, while holding, Zhu Yuan continuously consumes 1-3 Enhanced Shotgun Shells to deal massive damage with her attacks.

 Zhu Yuan has some of the most varied combos available in the game, with each offering unique benefits in different situations. Learning and mastering them all is quite a challenge. Fortunately, it’s possible to focus on the most commonly used, highest-damage combos, which this guide will cover. Zhu Yuan has access to two completely different basic attack combos, one for each Suppressive and Assault mode.
 Zhu Yuan’s Assault Mode Basic Attacks consist of a six-part attack combo (despite the game only listing five of the six parts). Here is the breakdown of the combo:
 Assault Mode Basic P1: Physical Melee Kick

 Assault Mode Basic P2: Ether Ranged Shotgun Blast

 Assault Mode Basic P3: Physical Melee Multi-Kick

 Assault Mode Basic P4: Ether Ranged Shotgun Jump Blast (Generates 1 Shell)

 Assault Mode Basic P5: Ether Ranged Shotgun Dash Blast (Generates 1 Shell)

 Assault Mode Basic P6: Ether Ranged Shotgun Slide

 The most valuable attacks in this sequence are Basic P4 and P5, as they deal the best damage and also generate Zhu Yuan's shells. Ideally, we’d like to access these as frequently as possible.
 Another unique aspect of Zhu Yuan’s basic attacks is that she can weave in a Dash Attack after any of the combo sequences above by triggering a Basic Attack by holding down the directional key. In this guide, we’ll be talking specifically about her left and right Dash Attacks (they’re the same as each other), as they are the most effective in her kit and the ones you should be using whenever mentioned. Dashing after attacks in this way will alter the sequencing of her next attack depending on which you dashed after. Here is a list of how using a side dash after each part of the Assault Mode basic attack changes things:
 Assault Mode Basic P1 -> Dash Attack -> Assault Mode Basic P3 (Optimal)

 Assault Mode Basic P2 -> Dash Attack -> Assault Mode Basic P3 (Avoid)

 Assault Mode Basic P3 -> Dash Attack -> Loop Back to Assault Mode Basic P3 (Avoid)

 Assault Mode Basic P4 -> Dash Attack -> Assault Mode Basic P5 (Avoid)

 Assault Mode Basic P5 -> Dash Attack -> Loop to Assault Mode Basic P3 (Optimal)

 Assault Mode Basic P6 -> Dash Attack -> Loop Back to Assault Mode Basic P3 (Avoid)

 The changes to attack ordering allow Zhu Yuan to execute higher damage, faster combos that generate more shells. Here is an example of a combo in action:
 Assault Mode Basic P1

 Dash Attack

 Assault Mode Basic P3

 Assault Mode Basic P4

 Assault Mode Basic P5

 Dash Attack

 Assault Mode Basic P3

 Assault Mode Basic P4

 Assault Mode Basic P5

 By using Dash Attacks, we can speed up Zhu Yuan’s standard rotation and loop/skip to the best parts of it.
 Zhu Yuan’s other Basic Attack moves are within Suppressive Mode, which, as mentioned above, needs to be entered by holding down the Basic Attack and waiting for Zhu Yuan to perform a short preparatory flip. The time needed for Zhu Yuan to enter Suppressive Mode is roughly 0.5 seconds, long enough that you don’t want to be constantly moving in and out of Assault and Suppressive unless necessary. The best approach is to enter Suppressive mode only when you have sufficient Enhanced Shells to consume (5 or 9 being optimal). Additionally, several abilities in Zhu Yuan’s kit allow her to immediately enter Suppressive Mode without delay as long as you immediately begin using Suppressive Mode Basics right after they finish. These abilities are:
 EX Special Attack

 Ultimate Attack

 Chain Attack

 After entering Suppression mode, continuously holding down the Basic Attack will cause Zhu Yuan to fire an Enhanced Shotgun combo consisting of 3 parts which if available, will each consume a number of Shotgun Shells to deal either tiny Physical (un-enhanced) or massive Ether damage (enhanced). Due to the poor multipliers on Zhu Yuan’s un-enhanced Suppressive Basics it’s never worth using them without Shells available. Here is how many Shells each attack uses:
 Suppressive Mode Basic P1 = 1 Shell

 Suppressive Mode Basic P2 = 1 Shell

 Suppressive Mode Basic P3 = 3 Shells (Deals triple the damage of P1 and P2)

 Just like Zhu Yuan’s Assault Mode Basic Attacks, she can also make use of a special Suppressive Mode Dodge Attack to alter and improve her Basic Attack sequences. We’ll again be making use of side Dash Attacks (left and right) as they are the most competitive in most cases. Here is how dashes affect the combo:
 Suppressive Mode Basic P1 -> Suppressive Mode Dash Attack -> Suppressive Mode Basic P3

 Suppressive Mode Basic P2 -> Suppressive Mode Dash Attack -> Suppressive Mode Basic P3

 Suppressive Mode Basic P3 -> Suppressive Mode Dash Attack -> Suppressive Mode Basic P3 (Loop)

 The key takeaway here is that we can use a Suppressive Mode Dash Attack following a Suppressive Mode Basic P3 to skip straight back to another P3 incredibly quickly, allowing us to consume our Shells much faster and increase Zhu Yuan’s burst potential. Here is an example combo that dumps all 9 Shells as fast as possible (a full gauge):
 Suppressive Mode Basic P1 (1 Shell)

 Suppressive Mode Basic P2 (1 Shell)

 Suppressive Mode Basic P3 (3 Shells)

 Suppressive Mode Dash Attack (1 Shell)

 Suppressive Mode Basic P3 (3 Shells)

 As mentioned above, Zhu Yuan has a Dash Attack for both Assault Mode and Suppressive Mode. For both modes, she has different Dash attacks for forward, back, left and right, but left and right are primarily used in both modes for her combos. They can be not only used mid-combo for cancels but also in general combat outside of combos.
 Zhu Yuan’s Dodge Counter is a quick Shotgun Blast that deals Ether damage and generates 1 Shotgun Shell, making it an optimal way to stack up Shells quickly against fast-attacking enemies. Following this Dodge Counter, Zhu Yuan skips straight to her Assault Mode Basic P3, allowing her to quickly chain attacks together if desired.
 Zhu Yuan’s Quick Assist and Assist Follow-Up both launch a Shotgun Blast dealing Ether damage and generating Shotgun Shells. Her Quick Assist generates 1 Shell and her Assist Follow-Up generates 3.
 Zhu Yuan’s EX Special Attack, Chain Attack, and Ultimate are all functionally the same but with varying damage multipliers. All of them trigger massive Shotgun Blasts that immediately place Zhu Yuan in Suppressive Mode allowing for immediate usage of Suppressive Mode Basics and generating 3 Shells each.
 To round off her kit, Zhu Yuan features an incredible Core Passive as well as an Additional Ability, both of which tremendously boost her damage output. Zhu Yuan’s Core Passive boosts the damage of all her Shell-Enhanced Suppressive Mode Basic Attacks and Dash Attacks by up to 40%, further increasing against Stunned targets by another 40% for a total of 80%. She also gains 6 Shells at the start of each combat. Meanwhile, with her Additional Ability if Zhu Yuan has a Support character or a character sharing either her Faction in the team, she’ll gain 30% Crit Rate for 10 seconds after using an EX Special, Chain, or Ultimate. This buff is all but guaranteed to be permanently active during Zhu Yuan’s main burst window where she unloads all her Shells (usually against Stunned enemies).
 Zhu Yuan’s build-and-spend kit plays perfectly into a Burst damage playstyle where she can build up Shells, Energy, and her Ultimate to unleash strong attacks on Stunned enemies in an incredibly short amount of time. At the time of her release, Zhu Yuan delivers the most Burst damage during a Stun window in the game, assuming she has all her kit at her disposal.

 How to play
 Zhu Yuan doesn’t like being on-field all that much, with Assault Mode attacks doing little damage and building few resources, but she can take on the role if necessary, as her Suppressive Mode Shotshell attacks can be very strong.
 The primary goal is to have enough Shotshells and Energy ready before every stun.
 With her Evasive Assist into Assist Follow-Up using up only 1 Assist Point and building 3 Shotshells, it’s an effective way to build them quickly without taking up too much time. This isn’t always ideal, however, as many Stunners don’t work well with on-fielding, it’s fine to have Zhu Yuan be the active character and then make use of her Dodge Counters and, if possible, Assist Counter to a Stunner to get both Shotshells and daze application.
 Zhu Yuan can get away with having 5-6 Shotshells and a little under 3/4s of her Energy before stuns, if being run with a Support that can provide Quick Assists. Manual Chain is mandatory for her best combos. Most moves will have Heavy Attacks that trigger Chain at inopportune times, as making use of Chain Attacks for Shotshell generation is important to get the most damage out.
 Thankfully, it’s very easy to use, as one needs to be holding down Basic Attack for Zhu Yuan’s Suppressive Mode Basic Attacks anyways.

 Teams & Synergy

 Synergy
 Below we list only the most important synergies for Zhu Yuan . The character can work with others if you know what to do and how to use them.

 Dialyn - Dialyn is decidedly the best Stunner for Zhu Yuan and far outperforms even double Support teams. Despite it's fast animations, Zhu Yuan's Ultimate is particularly hard hitting, and when paired with the ability to get 2 Ultimates and a Chain Attack in a combo, it leads to incredibly strong stun bursts. Dialyn's high Daze value and the relative ease in which Zhu Yuan can build resources for stuns leads to quick cycles and at times, more stuns in a fight than what could be achieved with other Stunners.
 Qingyi Anby - On-field Stun options are great for Zhu Yuan because they fill in for her downtime so no on-field time is wasted in between her damage windows. Qingyi is the most natural option and the best choice. She shares a faction with Zhu Yuan, she stuns very quickly, and she applies Stun DMG Multiplier debuffs to increase Zhu Yuan's damage against enemies. This means Zhu Yuan greatly benefits from Qingyi being present in her teams, however Anby is an option you can consider if you don't want to run Double Support team compositions and instead want to run a Stun Agent, as she applies a lot of Daze and fills in for Zhu Yuan's downtime, but beyond that point she lacks in extra utility which makes her viable, but worse.
 Pulchra Trigger - Having an opposite playstyle from Qingyi and Anby, Trigger and Pulchra serve as options that take much less of an on-field presence for Zhu Yuan to take up more of the field time instead. This style of team composition is very similar to her Double Support playstyle, which over time has proven to be her best. Trigger and Pulchra trade off an ability to deal higher Daze than their peers with very low field time and - most importantly - provide buffs to Zhu Yuan. While Qingyi still remains a superior choice as she also has buffs and higher Daze potential, both of these options outclass Anby who gives no buffs to Zhu Yuan whatsoever, making for perfectly good alternatives.
 Seed - Seed can and wants to be paired alongside other Attack Agents who function as main damage dealers in order for her kit to work well. This is because Seed is able to buff Attack Agents in several ways, giving them Energy, ATK, DMG dealt and CRIT DMG increases. For this reason, she works well as a mix of DPS and Support for almost every Attack Agent in the game, including Zhu Yuan.
 Nicole Yuzuha Astra Yao - These 3 generalist Support units are capable of servicing as the Support to any team in the game. Astra Yao provides Quick Assists, extra Chain Attacks, healing, super low field time, ATK, DMG and CRIT DMG buffs which makes her the overall best choice in almost all cases. Yuzuha on the other hand is the ultimate Anomaly buffer who's sporting awesome ATK and DMG% buffs applicable to any Agent as well, giving her strong general use potential. Nicole provides the sought-after DEF Shred and CRIT Rate at M6 which makes her competitive. They can work with any team in the game to great effect, whether that's by themselves or together, Nicole being particularly appreciated with Zhu Yuan as she also activates her Additional Ability which increases the whole party's Ether DMG on top of applying a good chunk of Ether Anomaly.
